name: Griffin Canyon — "If it's a creature, it gets +1/+1" lands on the target Griffin
notes: Was on the open list of demonstrative cards; the rider work of 2026-10-06 already covers it ("{T}: Untap target Griffin. If it's a creature, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn." reads "… target Griffin gets +1/+1" with an on-resolution "it is a creature" condition). Locked in here: Griffin Sentinel 1/3 becomes 2/4; the Canyon and Grizzly Bears are unchanged.
